concept: Socio - Religious Reform Movements in the 19th and 20th CE India
question: Which of following was established in Madras in 1864?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Veda Samaj.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Veda Samaj was established by Keshab Chandra Sen and K. Sridharalu Naidu.
 
• Established in Madras (Chennai) in 1864.
 
• The Veda Samaj was inspired by the Brahmo Samaj.
